changes.text:
CartCost.totalDutyAmount is deprecated: Tax and duty amounts are no longer available and will be removed in a future version.
Please see [the changelog](https://shopify.dev/changelog/tax-and-duties-are-deprecated-in-storefront-cart-api)
for more information.
